name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 22, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Pastor Michael Chavez, La Mirada Foursquare Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD - It is recommended the City Council present Chayila Kleist with a Community Spotlight Award.
5.1 Community Spotlight Award
5.2
RECOGNITION OF SPRING BEAUTIFICATION AWARD WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council present certificates of recognition to the 2021 Spring Beautification Awards Program recipients in the Most Outstanding and Most Improved categories.
5.2 Spring Beautification Winners
5.3
RECOGNITION OF THE LA MIRADA HIGH SCHOOL GIRLS VARSITY SOCCER TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the La Mirada High School Girls Varsity Soccer Team and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.3 LMHS Girls Varsity Soccer Team
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of June 8, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of June 8, 2021.
7.1 Minutes of June 8, 2021 Study Session
7.1 Minutes of June 8, 2021 City Council
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 22, 2021 in the total amount of $2,043,548.40.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING APRIL 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending April 2021.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING MAY 2021 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending May 2021.
7.4 Investment Report - May 2021
7.5
ANNUAL INVESTMENT REPORT AS OF MAY 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Annual Investment Report as of May 2021.
7.5 Annual Investment Report - May 2021
7.6
STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Statement of Investment Policy of the City of La Mirada for Fiscal Year 2021-22.
7.6 Statement of Investment Policy
7.7
LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION AGREEMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2021-22 - It is recommended the City Council approve the Fiscal Year 2021-22 agreement between the City of La Mirada and the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.7 La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Agreement
7.8
SOCIAL SERVICES FUNDING FOR FISCAL YEARS 2021-22 AND 2022-23 - It is recommended the City Council approve a La Mirada Meals on Wheels funding request in the amount of $9,000 for Fiscal Years 2021-22 and 2022-23, and in-kind contributions of office space and furnishings at the La Mirada Activity Center valued at $7,139; approve a Straight Talk, Inc. funding request in the amount of $58,381 for Fiscal Years 2021-22 and 2022-23, and in-kind contributions of office space, utilities, security, and custodial services at the La Mirada Resource Center valued at $47,688; approve a Southeast Area Social Services Funding Authority (SASSFA) funding request in the amount of $35,000 for Fiscal Years 2021-22 and 2022-23, and
in-kind contributions of office space and furnishings at the La Mirada Activity Center valued at $73,692; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreements on behalf of the City.
7.8 Social Services Funding
7.9
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE VEHICLES - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of one new heavy-duty cab chassis work truck with dump body from Penske Chevrolet of Cerritos in the amount of $49,110.75.
7.9 Authorization to Purchase Vehicles
7.10
AGREEMENT WITH THEATER DIRECT, INC. FOR TELEMARKETING SERVICES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Theater Direct, Inc. for telemarketing services for the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.10 Theater Direct Agreement
7.11
WAREHOUSE NON-EXCLUSIVE LICENSE FOR PHANTOM PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council approve the non-exclusive license for Fiscal Year 2021-22 for Phantom Projects and authorize the City Manager to execute the license on behalf of the City.
7.11 Phantom Projects Non-Exclusive License
7.12
COST-SHARING AND REIMBURSEMENT AGREEMENT AMONG I-5 JPA MEMBER CITIES FOR PUBLIC OUTREACH SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve the cost-sharing and reimbursement agreement for public outreach services with the Cities of Commerce, Downey, Norwalk, and Santa Fe Springs at a cost not to exceed $7,000 and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.12 Cost-Sharing and Reimbursement - I-5 JPA
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
ORDINANCE NO. 717 AMENDING THE ZONING CODE, TITLE 21 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE AND THE IMPERIAL HIGHWAY SPECIFIC PLAN (IHSP) AS FOLLOWS: AMEND SUBSECTION 21.62.075(a) OF CHAPTER 21.62, ELECTRIFIED FENCE STANDARDS; AMEND TABLE 21.68.050, OF CHAPTER 21.68, PARKING AND LOADING; AMEND TABLE 21.76.070, OF CHAPTER 21.76, SIGNS; AMEND TABLE 6-4, OFF-STREET PARKING REQUIREMENTS, OF THE IHSP; AND AMEND SECTION 6.9, SIGNS, OF THE IHSP - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the CEQA Exemption; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 717 amending Subsection 21.062.075(a), of Chapter 21.62, Electrified Fence Standards, of Title 21; Table 21.68.050, of Chapter 21.68, Parking and Loading, of Title 21; Table 21.76.070, of Chapter 21.76, Signs, of Title 21; Table 6-4, Off-Street Parking Requirements, of the IHSP; and Section 6.9, Signs, of the IHSP, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ordinance No. 717 Electrified Fence Standards
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-23 APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF STOP SIGNS AND ACCOMPANYING STOP PAVEMENT MARKINGS AT TWELVE DESIGNATED INTERSECTIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-23 approving the installation of Stop signs with accompanying STOP pavement markings at twelve designated intersections.
9.1 Resolution No. 21-23 Approving Installation of Stop Signs
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-24 APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION PROGRAM – RENTAL ASSISTANCE/ACCESSIBILITY MODIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-24 approving the City's participation in the Los Angeles Urban County Permanent Local Housing Allocation Program and authorizing the City Manager to sign a contract for funding and any additional documents.
9.2 Resolution No. 21.24 Approving Participation in Local Housing
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 21-25 RENAMING THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION AND ADOPTING AMENDED BYLAWS FOR THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-25 renaming the Public Safety Commission to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission and adopting amended bylaws for the Public Safety and Traffic Commission.
9.3 Resolution No. 21-25 Renaming the Public Safety Commission
10.
NEW BUSINESS
10.1
AGREEMENT WITH ROBERT SWEIBEL CONSULTING FOR MARKETING SERVICES FOR THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS - It is recommended the City Council approve a professional services agreement with Robert Sweibel Associates for marketing services pursuant to the terms of the Agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
10.1 Agreement for Marketing Svcs.
HOUSING SUCCESSOR
11.
NEW BUSINESS - HOUSING SUCCESSOR
11.1
AGREEMENT WITH THE WHOLE CHILD FOR HOMELESS PREVENTION AND RAPID REHOUSING SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council acting in its capacity as the Housing Successor Agency to the former La Mirada Redevelopment Agency approve an agreement with The Whole Child and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments on behalf of the City.
11.1 Agreement with the Whole Child
